fuka.en: Because his core skills are simple and he can provide immediate buffs, he is the safest all-around option.
Because Skill 3 lasts for 4 turns, a single switch-in can provide buffs that stay active for a long time.
Mio can cover Fuuka's weakness of lacking DEF reduction and Pierce. If she is at A6, she can use both Skill 1 and Skill 3 immediately upon entering.
Runa can cover Fuuka's weakness of lacking DEF reduction and Pierce. Her A6 effect lets her apply her strongest debuff on the first turn she enters.
At A1 or higher, she can use Theurgy immediately upon entering, grant a high amount of Pierce, and then either buff with Skill 2 or recharge Theurgy with Skill 3.

Condition: Fuuka A6. Across 4 swap-ins, Katayama can use Skill 1 + 3 to Down enemies during key damage windows. Her AoE DEF reduction, Shock, and amplification of damage dealt to Downed enemies greatly increase total damage.

On Fire, Ice, and Elec teams, Koromaru is one of Fuuka's best Shift Member options. Aside from his passive, he can apply all of his debuffs as soon as he enters, reducing enemy DEF and changing their weaknesses.

puppet-wavecatcher.en: Use Mayumi's additional turn to trigger follow-up attacks more and the penetration buff lasts for 1 turn longer, allowing for stable damage output.

puppet-wavecatcher.it: alti buff di CRIT DMG, e la capacità di recupero SP di Riko permette a Miyu di recuperare SP e attivare più follow-up.
puppet-wavecatcher.en: High CRIT DMG buffs, as well as Riko's SP recovery ability allows Miyu to recover SP, allowing follow-up attacks to be triggered more.

puppet-wavecatcher.it: può concedere un aumento del danno Resonance in un bucket indipendente tramite l'uso di item.

rin-firecracker.en: Enhances TECHNICAL effects and reduces DEF of all enemies, and shares the mechanism that requires Burned enemies.

rin-firecracker.en: Applies an AoE DEF reduction, inflicts Burn, and increases enemies’ Fire damage taken.

rin-firecracker.it: il suo valore aumenta molto con un DPS Fire; inoltre può applicare Burn ai nemici con la Skill 3.
rin-firecracker.en: Junpei Iori’s value increases significantly when a Fire attribute DPS is present. Additionally, Junpei Iori can inflict Burn on enemies by using Skill 3.

skull.en: Provides high ATK and CRIT Mult buffs, and by lowering Ryuji’s HP while granting a Shield, further amplifies his damage that scales with lower HP.

violet.it: permette a Kasumi di usare più spesso l'HIGHLIGHT, la sua fonte di danno principale.
violet.en: Enables Kasumi to use HIGHLIGHT more frequently, which is her core damage source.

violet.it: l'HIGHLIGHT di Kasumi può andare a critico e Riko fornisce un forte buff di CRIT DMG; poiché la passiva di Riko richiede 5 o più colpi in 2 turni, un approccio è equipaggiare Kasumi con i set [Departure] + [Control] per aumentare il numero totale di colpi. Ad Awareness 6, entrambe le attivazioni automatiche della Skill 1 concesse dalla Skill 3 contano per attivare l'effetto della Skill 2 di Kasumi.
violet.en:
Kasumi’s HIGHLIGHT can trigger CRITs, and Riko provides a strong CRIT DMG buff. Since Riko’s passive requires landing 5 or more hits within 2 turns to activate, one approach is to equip Kasumi with the [Departure] + [Control] sets to increase her total number of hits.
At Awareness 6, both of the automatic Skill 1 activations granted by Skill 3 are each counted toward triggering Kasumi’s Skill 2 effect.

violet.it: l'attivazione automatica della Skill 3 di [Strategist] J&C da Awareness 1 vale anche per l'attivazione automatica della Skill 1 di Kasumi dalla Skill 2, permettendo di usare la Skill 1 due volte in una volta.
violet.en: [Strategist] J&C’s automatic Skill 3 activation from Awareness 1 also applies to Kasumi’s automatic Skill 1 activation from Skill 2, allowing Skill 1 to be used twice at once.
